verdict.rationale: Shortwave's evidence only shows it acting as an MCP *client* (connecting its AI Assistant to other apps' MCP servers) or integrating with third-party APIs like Zapier/GitHub — none of this constitutes Shortwave itself exposing a documented public API for external developers to drive the product. Direct probes for llms.txt, docs-as-markdown, and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404s, confirming no discoverable public API surface.
